biotools.summary: DANGO is a software tool for the automated annotation of glycolipidomic datasets, supporting processing and annotation of mass spectrometry data to characterize glycan and lipid moieties. It integrates with the GRITS Toolbox and proposes candidate structures to the user based on experimental data.
